Essex, United Kingdom216 contributions

Authentic dinner
Oct 2019 • Couples
You could easily walk right past this place. It is nestled in a large colourful block just down from the Rex hotel on the 2nd floor. You can either walk up the stairs or pay around 20p to use the lift. There are several restaurants in the block but this one was well advertised. It's like a little simple cafe with balcony and the odd leak. The small simple kitchen produces really tasty authentic food. The only real flaw we encountered was that there were some chicken pieces in the Mrs prawn dish and she is a pescatarian . Tasty food at a reasonable price . Worth a visit if passing by and looking for something traditional.
